text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
One day in Landosol,
a certain girl makes preparations to leave town.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ある日のランドソルで、一人の少女が
街を旅立つ準備におわれていた。

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
A town by the sea. Now that sounds lovely.
Excuse me! Is this everything?
text_block_list.orig_text:
──目的地は、
海沿いの街……
運ぶ荷物はこれで全部ですか？

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text:
Yup, that's all of it. You sure you'll be okay on your own, though?
That town's pretty far, not to mention you've got
the horse and wagon to worry about.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ、
よろしく頼むよ。　
それにしても、
一人で大丈夫かい？
あそこの街は遠いからね……
おまけに馬と荷車を引きながらだ。

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
No problem!
The horse seemed really docile, so it should be fine.
text_block_list.orig_text:
任せてください！
馬のことなら平気です。
あの子、
優しそうだったし。

text_block_list.name: Ruffian 1
text_block_list.text: Tch! What're you thinkin', hiring a runt like that for the job?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
けっ！　
あんなガキに頼む仕事かよ！

text_block_list.name: Ruffian 2
text_block_list.text:
You're gonna regret passing us up, buddy!
Big-time! Tch!
text_block_list.orig_text:
俺たちに頼んでおけばよかったって後悔しても
知らねぇからな！　
けっ！

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text:
Ignore them. They're just salty because you got the job.
Their fault for trying to force more money out of me.
text_block_list.orig_text:
気にするな。
きみに仕事を取られた腹いせに、
文句を言ってるだけさ。
報酬をふっかける方が悪いのにな。

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text: Ahaha... Thanks. I appreciate it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あはは……
ありがとうございます。

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text:
Oh yeah. That guy over there's doing a different job for me,
but he's going to the same place as you.You might as well go together.
Hey, you! Mind coming over here for a 'sec?
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだ。
あそこにさっき別の仕事を頼んだ人がいるんだけど、
行先が同じ街なんだ。
良かったら一緒に行くといいよ。
おーい君！　
ちょっとこっちに来てくれ！

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text:
This gal here's delivering goods to the same town as you.
How about going together with her?
Better to be safe than sorry, especially when you're out of town.
text_block_list.orig_text:
この子に君と同じ街まで荷物を運んでもらうんだけど、
せっかくだから一緒に行くといい。
街の外では何があるかわからないしね。

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
Hello! Funny how we're going to the same place, isn't it?
Umm... I don't mind going together, but it's up to you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はじめまして。
あなたが同じ街に行く人？
えっと……
一緒に行って迷惑じゃない、
かな？

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
Great!
I'm Djeeta. Pleasure to meet you!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ありがとう……！
私はジータ。よろしくね！

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
Oh, so you're delivering a letter?
Makes sense. You seem pretty nimble, which is perfect should anything happen.
text_block_list.orig_text:
──そっか。
あなたは手紙を運んでるんだ。
身軽だし、
何かあった時に動きやすいのは大事だよね。

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
I have to be honest, though.
Part of me was worried if I could do this on my own.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……本当はね、
この仕事を一人でこなせるか、
ちょっとだけ不安だったんだ。

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
I've done a similar job before,
but I was pretty much alone the entire time.
It got pretty lonely without anyone to talk to.
text_block_list.orig_text:
前にも同じような仕事はやったことがあるんだけど、
その時は最初から最後までずっと一人で、
朝から夕方まで、
話し相手が誰もいなくて寂しかったなぁ……

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
But hey, you're here today! 
Now I won't need to worry about that, haha.
text_block_list.orig_text:
今日はあなたがいてくれるから、
寂しくないんだ。
えへへ……

text_block_list.name: Ruffian 1
text_block_list.text: There she is. Hold up, kid!
text_block_list.orig_text:
──きやがったな。
止まれ、
そこのガキ！

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text: You're... those two from earlier, aren't you?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あなたたちは、
さっきの……

text_block_list.name: Ruffian２
text_block_list.text:
Let's make this quick. Hand over everything in that wagon.
And don't try to pull anything funny, either! Come on!
text_block_list.orig_text:
お前らが運んでるもん、
全部渡してもらおうか！
抵抗しなけりゃ見逃してやるよ！　
おら、
さっさとしな！

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, but no can do.
I took this job on, so I have a duty to finish it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それは……
出来ません。
頼まれた仕事は、
ちゃんと最後までやり遂げないと。

text_block_list.name: Ruffian１
text_block_list.text:
The hell? She ain't even scared.
Whatever. That'll change soon enough. Aight, get her!
text_block_list.orig_text:
コイツビビッてねぇのか……？
余裕ぶってるのも今のうちだ！　
おい、
やっちまうぞ！

text_block_list.name: Ruffian２
text_block_list.text: You're goin' down, ya little runt!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おう！　
覚悟しろ！

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
They only care about me, so you stay back!
I can handle this on my o—
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}は下がってて！
あの人たちは私を狙ってる。
だからここは私だけで……

text_block_list.name: Ruffian１
text_block_list.text:
We ain't got no beef with you, just that runt over there!
Outta the way!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんだテメェは！　
用があるのはそっちのガキだけだ！
邪魔すんな！

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, {0}!
Don't worry, though. I meant it when I said I can handle this on my own.
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}……！　ありがとう！
……でも大丈夫。
ここから先は、
一人でなんとかしてみせる。

text_block_list.name: Ruffian１
text_block_list.text: Damn, she's really steppin' up! Eat steel!
text_block_list.orig_text:
まんまと前に出やがって！　
そらよっ！

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text: Yah!
text_block_list.orig_text: やあっ！

text_block_list.name: Ruffian１
text_block_list.text: Gurgh! The hell?! She's fast!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぐおぁっ！　
コイツ、
速い……！

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text: One down, one to go!
text_block_list.orig_text:
もう一人っ！　
たあっ！

text_block_list.name: Ruffian２
text_block_list.text: Gah! W-what's the deal here?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
がはぁっ！　
ど、
どうなってんだ！？

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
I'd rather not take this any further,
but that all comes down to you. Give up or get beat up!
text_block_list.orig_text:
これ以上はやめておきたいんだけど……
まだ続けるなら、
容赦はしません！

text_block_list.name: Ruffian１
text_block_list.text: Tch! Come on, let's bounce!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちっ……！　
おい、
行くぞ！

text_block_list.name: Ruffian２
text_block_list.text: Dammit! We'll get you back for this!
text_block_list.orig_text:
くそっ！　
覚えてろよ！

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
...Phew. Thanks for that.
You okay?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
ふぅ。
さっきはありがとう。
怪我してない？

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
Thank goodness.
Sorry, I got you wrapped up in my business.
text_block_list.orig_text:
良かったぁ……
ごめんね。
私のもめごとに巻き込んじゃって。

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
We should get away from here, quick.
No guaranteeing they won't be back with more people.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あの人たちが仲間を連れて戻ってくるかもしれないし、
すぐにここを離れないと。

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
Honestly, though.
First they try to hike up prices, then they take it out on me!
text_block_list.orig_text:
それにしてもひどいよね。
報酬を釣り上げたから仕事を取られたのに、
逆恨みなんてさ。

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
They probably saw me as some kid, but too bad for them.
I'm no poser when it comes to my dream to become a capable
skyfarer. Training's part of my daily routine!
text_block_list.orig_text:
私なら倒せるって思ったんだろうけど、
私、
これでも、
ちゃんと一人前の騎空士になれるよう、
毎日鍛練してるんだから。

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
Do you know what a skyfarer is, actually?
Basically, we gather up crews and
explore the world in our airships.
text_block_list.orig_text:
騎空士って知ってる？　
騎空団に所属して、
大きな飛空艇……
騎空艇で、
世界中を冒険する人たちのことなんだけど……

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
Never heard of skyfarers, huh...
Figures. I barely see any airships around these days.
text_block_list.orig_text:
知らない、
よね……
最近は騎空艇もほとんど見かけなくなったし……

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
Truth be told, my dad's a skyfarer as well.
Even now, he's off exploring somewhere far from this continent.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……私の父さんはね、
騎空士なんだ。
今はこの大陸じゃないどこかへ、
冒険の旅に出てる。

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
That's my dream. To be a fully-fledged skyfarer like him.
So I set out to do just that. I even formed my own crew.
Which I'm the only part of. And I don't even have an airship.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いつか私も、
父さんみたいな騎空士になりたい……
そう思って私も騎空団を結成して、
騎空士になった。
まだ団員は私だけで、
騎空艇もないんだけどね……

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
That's why I'm doing all these jobs.
Lets me save up money for one, plus it's good training!
text_block_list.orig_text:
だからまずは騎空艇を買うために、
修行を兼ねて色んな仕事をしてるんだ。

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
And while I'm at it... You tried to help me earlier, right?
That got me thinking. It'd...It'd be really nice to have crewmates like that.
I'd have their back, and they'd have mine.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それで……
あのね。
さっき助けてくれた時、
私、
思ったんだ。
こんな風に仲間と助け合えたらな……
って。

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
So yeah! How does joining my crew sound?
I really, REALLY wanna explore the skies with you!
Please...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
お願い！
　
私の騎空団に入ってくれないかな！？
あなたと一緒に、
空を冒険したくって……
だから……！

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
For real?
Woo! My first crewmate!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いいの……？
やったぁ！　
初めての仲間だー！

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
Oh, sorry. The excitement kinda got me, haha.
Anyway! It's great to have you on board, {0}!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ、
ごめんね！　
嬉しくてつい……
えへへ。
これからよろしくね！　{0}！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
And thus, spurned on by the allure of adventure,
{0} became the newest member of Djeeta's crew.
text_block_list.orig_text:
こうして{0}はジータにいざなわれ、
騎空団に所属する騎空士として活動を開始した。
